call_action_host.description: Host of the click-to-call endpoint for this tenant, e.g. portal.hoiio.net

call_action_path.description: Path of the click-to-call flow for this tenant, e.g. /_o/api/v2/flows/<id>/execute

token_issuer_host.description: Host of the ws-token-issuer Function URL, e.g. abc123.lambda-url.ap-southeast-1.on.aws

token_issuer_path.description: Path of the token issuer, usually just /

api_shared_secret.description: Per-tenant secret for click-to-call and token issuer. Stored encrypted; injected into the header; never exposed to the browser.
